entities.summary: Barbara Oteng Gyasi is a Ghanaian politician and a former Member of Parliament for Prestea-Huni Valley constituency of the Western Region of Ghana. She is a member of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), and was a Deputy Minister for Lands and Natural Resources in Ghana and also the former Minister of Tourism, Culture and Creative Arts.
